load_vocoder_component: load a vocoder model from a diffusers safetensors directory into a target device
resolve_vocoder_class: resolve a vocoder model class from a diffusers _class_name config entry via ModelRegistry
check_vocoder_offload: check whether a vocoder should be CPU-offloaded based on server_args.vae_cpu_offload
build_vocoder_with_dtype: build a vocoder instance with a specified precision dtype and apply state dict weights
summarize_vocoder_loader: summarize the VocoderLoader class and its load_customized method
